description: Public holidays of any of about 250 countries and regions for a given year, with optional subdivision, language and category. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: JSON. {country, year, subdiv, holidays:[{date, name}], count}

categories.description: Holiday categories, default ["public"]; e.g. public, bank, school, government, optional, half_day

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, IL

language.description: Language of the holiday names, e.g. de or en_US; default: English where available, else the country's own language

observed.description: Include substitute days such as "Christmas Day (observed)"

subdiv.description: State / province / region code or name, e.g. BY, Bayern, CA, SCT

name: holidays_lookup
title: Public holidays lookup
